# Security reporting — 1.0.0

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)
Please read the canonical [security policy](../docs/SECURITY.md). Report vulnerabilities privately to Đăng Khoa at i.am@dangkhoa.dev, with synthetic data and sanitized logs. Do not disclose keys, accounts, database dumps, active cookies, vault secrets or unpatched exploit details in public issues.

The project is server-side encryption, not zero knowledge. Deployment-specific recovery and KEK custody must be independently verified.
